messages.text:
Hey, hey!
We'll take care of you!{be01}

Rob: My...my cute little Pokémon!{be01}
Sal: My baby lost!

Hey, hey, hey! What's wrong?
Are you lost or something?{be01}

Us bad dudes are getting together
to boast about our Pokémon!

Come on! You're telling me that you've
only got one Pokémon ready for battle?{be01}
I can't call myself a bad dude if I fight
two against one! It's not fair at all!
